fact: On 5 September 2023 the ministry launched digitised secure land titles issued through a tracking platform, printable at the five land conservations (Conakry, Labé, Kindia, Kankan, Nzérékoré), with titles carrying a QR code.
title: Guinée : le Ministère de l'Habitat lance les titres fonciers numérisés et sécurisés
